name: A turn that says the work is done and working is a success
case: The agent runs the tests, which pass, and ends its turn saying all the tests pass and it pushed the branch. Boop plays the finish as a success, never a failure or a mere reply.
why: The brain judges each finish's outcome from what the turn-end says; react.move's success is a turn done whose last message says the work is done and working

steps.prompt: fix the failing date test and push

steps.message: All tests pass, and I pushed the branch.
